at least \(\delta\); summation contradicts \(K_\phi\ge0\) and the orbitwise
carrier ceiling, giving \textup{(ii)}.  The complementary ordinary law is
\eqref{eq:ns-scale-saturation-law}, giving \textup{(iii)}.  The calculation
uses the scale-critical normalized carrier itself and never divides physical
price by \(r\).
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Target-local record-scale reduction with totalized tails]
\label{thm:ns-target-local-record-scale-reduction}
Let \(\mathfrak b\) be an algebraically reachable ordinary recurrent
Navier--Stokes branch whose scales collapse.  Apply the canonical record-scale
selector, so \(a\le0\).  Use rational cutoffs \(\chi_R\) in the moving chart,
retain every annular convection, pressure, diffusion, translation, and
dilation term, and totalize the exhaustion \(R\to\infty\).  For a periodic
physical domain the collapsing chart is lifted to its expanding rescaled
cover before this exhaustion; the fixed torus mean is not used with the
nonperiodic vector field \(y\cdot\nabla\).  Denote the resulting ordinary
translation-invariant mean, when it exists, by \(\mathfrak m\), and set
\[
 O(V):=\mathfrak m\bigl(|V-\mathfrak mV|^2\bigr),
 \qquad
 P(V):=\nu\mathfrak m(|\nabla V|^2).
\]
Exactly one of the following occurs:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(M\arabic*)}]
\item a mean, exhaustion, annular flux, pressure tail, divergence, or chart
relation takes a nonordinary value and produces its typed target-aligned
successor;
\item the invariant law \(\varpi\) satisfies
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-record-scale-zero-mode}
 \int\left(P+\frac a2O+B_\infty\right)\,\dd\varpi=0,
\end{equation}
where \(B_\infty\) is the ordinary total-graph value of the glued annular and
exhaustion current.  On the tail-free cell \(B_\infty=0\).  Its \(a=0\)
subcell has \(P=0\) and is Galilean constant on each connected retained
component.  Its \(a<0\) subcell satisfies the scale-balance relation
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-record-scale-balance}
 \int P\,\dd\varpi
 =\int\frac{-a}{2}O\,\dd\varpi.
\end{equation}
This relation defines a scale-relative equality cell; it does not force
\(P\) or \(O\) to vanish.  The equality cell, its nonzero boundary current,
and every failed exhaustion value are passed to target-cyclic circulation
and least-coordinate refinement.
\end{enumerate}
This conclusion concerns only the generated target-active branch; it makes no claim
about recurrent Navier--Stokes states outside its target cell.
The Navier--Stokes dilation row has the coefficient and sign in
\eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-zero-mode}.  Hence the abstract sign identity
\eqref{eq:branch-local-sign-identity} applies only to branches that generate
that different row, while the Navier--Stokes \(a<0\) cell remains in the
scale-balance stratum.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Test \eqref{eq:ns-moving-frame-equation} against
\(\chi_R(V-\mathfrak m_RV)\).  Incompressibility converts convection and
pressure into annular currents; diffusion, translation, and the derivative
of the local mean produce further explicit boundary coordinates.  The same
calculation applies on the expanding lift of a shrinking periodic chart.
If a coordinate fails to converge in the exhaustion graph, its least value
is \textup{(M1)}.  On an ordinary exhaustion, signed gluing gives the single
limit current \(B_\infty\).

For \(W=V-\mathfrak mV\), the ordinary boundary-free dilation identity in
three dimensions is
\[
 \mathfrak m\bigl(W\cdot( W+y\cdot\nabla W)\bigr)
 =-\frac12\mathfrak m(|W|^2)=-\frac12O.
\]
Stationarity annihilates the time coboundary.  Pairing the remaining moving
equation with \(W\) therefore gives
\eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-zero-mode}.  When \(B_\infty=0\), the cell \(a=0\)
has \(P=0\); the connected gradient kernel and Galilean quotient make it
target-null.  On \(a<0\), the same identity is
\eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-balance}, so the compiler retains it as a
scale-relative equality row rather than applying the gradient kernel.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Navier--Stokes ordinary-cell resaturation]
\label{cor:ns-ordinary-cell-resaturation}
For the Navier--Stokes public presentation, the target-cyclic compiler uses
viscosity as the native mobility, incompressibility and pressure as the
constraint functor, Galilean and parabolic transformations as quotient and
record-scale charts, and the local suitable-energy form as carrier.  These
substitutions generate the record-scale mean row of
\cref{thm:ns-target-local-record-scale-reduction}; it is not additional
specialization data.  Consequently an ordinary zero-price stationary law is
not terminal.  Exactly one of the following occurs:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(N\arabic*)}]
\item on the tail-free \(a=0\) cell, \eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-zero-mode}
gives \(P=0\); the connected gradient kernel and Galilean quotient make the
cell target-null;
\item on \(a<0\), the scale-balance row
\eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-balance}, or a nonzero ordinary value of
\(B_\infty\), is adjoined to the circulation ideal.  Its least nonzero
target-cyclic pairing is divided into signed dyadic cells and becomes the
next scale, nonlinear, pressure, exterior, constraint, or boundary
successor;
\item a mean, localization, integration-by-parts, pressure, chart, or
realization operation is nonordinary and its first total-graph value is the
next target-active successor.
\end{enumerate}
In \textup{(N2)}--\textup{(N3)} the selected current is passed to
\cref{def:zero-price-resaturation-successor}.  Hence the ordinary stationary
law cannot remain as an unexamined Navier--Stokes equality model.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply \cref{thm:target-cyclic-joint-kernel-descent}.  The first localization
of the viscous production by the covariant spatial-mean covector is precisely
the calculation in
\cref{thm:ns-target-local-record-scale-reduction}.  On the ordinary
tail-free \(a=0\) cell, its joint kernel is Galilean constant and gives
\textup{(N1)}.  On \(a<0\), the exact dilation calculation gives
\eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-balance}, not vanishing oscillation.  The generated
mobility-annihilator and circulation tests select its least target-active
pairing, giving \textup{(N2)}.  A failed mean, pressure, constraint, chart, or realization
operation is case \textup{(K3)} and gives \textup{(N3)}.  Thus the list is a
specialization of the general descent theorem rather than an independent
Navier--Stokes closure argument.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Navier--Stokes recurrent-component reduction]
\label{thm:ns-recurrent-component-reduction}
Fix a rational physical stratum \(E>0\).  On every algebraically reachable
Navier--Stokes recurrent component in \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\), the
target-aligned recurrent closure compiler on a full active signature \(\mathfrak b\)
has exactly one of the following outputs: a target-null fixed-scale state; a
target-null tail-free \(a=0\) state; a target-active scale-balance circulation
cell; a nonlinear, pressure, exterior, scale, constraint, chart, fidelity,
storage, or realization successor; or a cofinal recurrent-current system
whose cumulative join is reprojected.  The joint limit is target-null,
exposes a finite source-resolved primal or polar successor, or is a
primal--polar fixed structural atom.  Every ordinary target-active
realization of that atom enters the canonical target-retaining orbit and
cumulative-current rebasing.  In
particular scale
collapse never removes target-aligned structure from the compiler.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Initialize \cref{def:target-aligned-recurrent-closure-compiler} with the
Navier--Stokes shell covector and signed local-energy carrier.  Its aggregate
row is generated on \(\Spine_{\Sigma_{\rm sing},\mathfrak b}\) by
\cref{thm:projection-first-saturation}; it is the target projection of
convection, pressure, exterior, chart, and scale currents after signed
gluing.  Let a target-active recurrent component
be algebraically reachable.  If its record scale is bounded
away from zero, \cref{lem:ns-fixed-scale-closure} makes its zero-expenditure
ordinary component spatially constant and target-null.  Hence its scale must
collapse.  Apply the canonical nonincreasing record chart and
\cref{thm:ns-target-local-record-scale-reduction}.  Alternative
\textup{(M1)} is the corresponding typed successor.
Alternative \textup{(M2)} gives
\[
 \int\left(\nu\mathfrak m|\nabla V|^2+\frac a2\,
       \mathfrak m|V-\mathfrak mV|^2+B_\infty\right)\,\dd\varpi=0,
 \qquad a\le0.
\]
On the tail-free \(a=0\) cell, the viscous production vanishes and the
component is target-null.  On \(a<0\), viscous production is balanced by the
scale current and defines the equality cell
\eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-balance}.  A nonzero \(B_\infty\) is its boundary
successor.  Target-current circulation and prospective accountability select
the least target-aligned value on either cell; this is alternative
\textup{(N2)} or \textup{(N3)} of
\cref{cor:ns-ordinary-cell-resaturation}.  Apply the signed-dyadic return
construction of the general recurrent compiler.  A new
coordinate is a proper successor.  Equivalent recurrent-current successors
are accumulated in their cumulative joint record.  By
\cref{thm:continuum-composition-no-creation,thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion,thm:three-output-target-aligned-current-compiler}
the result is target-null, has a least unprocessed finite joint increment, or
is a primal--polar fixed structural atom retaining the original
public-equation and cofinal shell rows.  Apply
\cref{thm:ns-realization-gate-alternative} to the latter
two values.  Its nonordinary and finite-prefix branches are the next
successors, while its fixed ordinary branch is a member of
the contact-realizable orbit fiber of
\cref{def:ns-contact-realizable-target-cover}.  These alternatives exhaust
the recurrent component.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Navier--Stokes unnormalized horizon compiler]
\label{thm:ns-unnormalized-horizon-compiler}
Fix a rational physical stratum \(E>0\) and an algebraically reachable
target-active signature \(\mathfrak b\).  On the minimal same-origin
Navier--Stokes successor graph define
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-unnormalized-horizon-price}
 \Delta_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}(N)
 :=\inf_{(e_0,\ldots,e_{N-1})}
       \sum_{j<N}p_{{\rm NS},\Phys}(e_j),
\end{equation}
where the infimum is over layered paths satisfying the moving equation,
incompressibility, pressure, suitable-energy carrier, chart, scale,
same-origin, target-shell, and all previously generated successor relations.
The finite Navier--Stokes cylinder hierarchy computes the dual values
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-unnormalized-horizon-dual}
 \Delta_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}(N)
 =\sup_{m,(V_j),(\delta_j)}
 \left\{\sum_{j<N}\delta_j:
 \begin{array}{l}
 V_0=V_N=0,\\
 p_{{\rm NS},m}+V_j\circ\pi_--V_{j+1}\circ\pi_+
       -\delta_j\in
       \overline{\mathcal K^0_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b,j}}
 \end{array}\right\}.
\end{equation}
It is evaluated before the normalized cycle price.  At this compiler stage
exactly one of the following transitions occurs; neither transition is a
terminal third outcome.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(H\arabic*)}]
\item Some finite horizon has a checked lower bound larger than \(E\), which
excludes a singular cascade in the signature.
\item Every horizon is compatible with total expenditure at most \(E\).  The
compiler passes to the next target-aligned operation an infinite augmented
same-origin ledger with
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-cumulative-source-growth}
 \sup_N\Pi_{{\rm NS},N}\le E,\qquad
 A_{\Phi,N}=N,\qquad
 (Q_{{\rm NS},N_k}^{c_*})_+\ge N_k/5\longrightarrow\infty
\end{equation}
for a source \(c_*\) and a cofinal subsequence.  The moving-microscope,
scale-balance, circulation, and realization rows act on this augmented
ledger.
\end{enumerate}
In particular, a zero-density scale-balance circulation cannot be a terminal
output of the Navier--Stokes evaluator.  It is only a support selector for the
unnormalized ledger in \eqref{eq:ns-cumulative-source-growth}.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Specialize \cref{thm:cumulative-carrier-duality} through the minimal
target-active realization.  Specialization preserves the layered successor
graph, public physical valuation, ordered cone, source coordinates, and
same-origin relations, giving
\eqref{eq:ns-unnormalized-horizon-price}--
\eqref{eq:ns-unnormalized-horizon-dual}.  The public kinetic-energy carrier
bounds every disjoint prefix by \(E\).  Alternative \textup{(U1)} is
\textup{(H1)}.  Alternative \textup{(U2)}, together with the unit shell
identity, is \textup{(H2)}.  The final assertion follows because every later
state is joined with \eqref{eq:ns-cumulative-source-growth} before target
projection.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Navier--Stokes carrier-polar recursion]
\label{thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion}
On an algebraically reachable target-active signature \(\mathfrak b\), let
\(Q_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{o}\) be the canonical owner of the cumulative
shell current.  The specialized physical carrier cone is
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-target-local-carrier-cone}
 \mathscr D_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{\Phys}
 :=\overline{
 \delta\mathscr K_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}
 +\operatorname{cone}\{\mathsf J[D],\mathsf J[M],
              \mathsf J[\mu_{\rm NS}],\mathsf J[B_{\rm ext}^{+}]\}
 +\Null_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}},
\end{equation}
where a displayed production is included only through its local suitable-
energy domination row and compatible convection, pressure, cutoff, and chart
currents have already been glued with their signs.  If
\(Q_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{o}\) is outside this cone, the finite cylinder
hierarchy generates a separating covector
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-carrier-polar-separator}
 \lambda_{\mathfrak b}(Q_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{o})>0,
 \qquad
 \lambda_{\mathfrak b}\le0
 \text{ on }\mathscr D_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{\Phys},
\end{equation}
then adjoins its Leray-projected adjoint transport, pressure descent,
moving-chart pullback, Reynolds polarizations, commutator productions, and
all first nonordinary graph values.  The resulting target-visible component
is the next one of the existing \(\Geom/\Caus/\Abs/\Lift/\Bdry\) successor
cells with the complete parent ledger.

No Navier--Stokes equality kernel, scale-balance law, or zero-density
circulation reaches the ordinary-orbit realization row until this recursion
is fixed for every primal and polar owner.  At a fixed point, every remaining
target-aligned scale current is accompanied by the complete family of
separators proving its failure to be physical production, exact storage,
target-null current, or exterior input.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Substitute the localized momentum equation, pressure graph, signed suitable-
energy identity, Leray quotient, and parabolic chart into
\cref{def:target-local-carrier-polar-successor,thm:recursive-carrier-polar-exhaustion}.
These substitutions give exactly \eqref{eq:ns-target-local-carrier-cone}.
The specialized source-adapted dual grammar is the adjoint module and defect
polarization already generated on
\(X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\), so
\eqref{eq:carrier-polar-separator} becomes
\eqref{eq:ns-carrier-polar-separator} and every descendant lies in one of the
seven totalized successor cells.  The final assertion is
\cref{cor:no-pre-polar-realization} after specialization.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Navier--Stokes target-spine circulation evaluator]
\label{cor:ns-target-spine-circulation-evaluator}
Fix rational \(E>0\).  For every algebraically reachable Navier--Stokes
signature \(\mathfrak b\) in \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\), let
\(a_{{\rm NS},\Sigma}\) be the normalized shell return current on
\(\Spine_{{\rm NS},\Sigma_{\rm sing},\mathfrak b}\), represented by the
incidence core \(\mathsf M_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\), and let
\(p_{{\rm NS},\Phys}\) be the restriction of the suitable local-energy
carrier admitted by the charging graph, with generated continuous lower
envelopes \(p_{{\rm NS},N}\uparrow p_{{\rm NS},\Phys}\).  Denote by
\(\mathcal K^{0}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\) the specialized local equation and
positivity cone before edge coboundaries are adjoined.  The nested
Navier--Stokes cylinder hierarchy computes
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-sharp-cycle-price}
 \delta_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{\rm cyc}
 =\inf_{\gamma}
   \int p_{{\rm NS},\Phys}\,\dd\gamma
 =\sup_{N,V,\delta}\left\{\delta:
 \begin{array}{l}
 p_{{\rm NS},N}+V\circ\pi_- -V\circ\pi_+\\
 \hfill{}-\delta a_{{\rm NS},\Sigma}
 \in\overline{\mathcal K^{0}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}}
 \end{array}\right\}.
\end{equation}
The normalized primal measure is stored jointly with
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-unnormalized-return-cocycle}
 \Gamma_{{\rm NS},N}=\sum_{j<N}\delta_{e_j},
 \qquad
 A_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,N}
 =\int a_{{\rm NS},\Sigma}\,\dd\Gamma_{{\rm NS},N}\ge\eta N,
 \qquad A_{\Phi,N}=N
\end{equation}
on completed shell prefixes.  The first cocycle records the selected
signed-dyadic return current; the second records the full normalized shell
progress.  Neither is replaced by the probability normalization of the
circulation law.
Here the primal circulation includes the moving equation, incompressibility,
pressure graph, signed suitable-energy carrier, scale covariance, target-
cyclic productions, same-origin relations, and the six typed graph-boundary
cells after restriction to
\(X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\).  The following computation is exhaustive:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(N\arabic*)}]
\item the unnormalized horizon compiler produces a finite cumulative lower
bound above \(E\), excluding the branch without a per-return estimate;
\item every cumulative source owner is processed by
\cref{thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion}; cone membership charges or cancels it,
while strict separation creates the next target-aligned dual successor;
\item positive \(\delta_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{\rm cyc}\) produces a finite
local carrier-potential identity and excludes recurrent singular progress;
\item infeasibility produces a finite local \(-1\)-identity;
\item on a primal--polar fixed cell, zero recurrent price reconstructs the
invariant circulation and selects its
positive target support.  Rejoining that selector with
\eqref{eq:ns-unnormalized-return-cocycle} and
\eqref{eq:ns-cumulative-source-growth} initializes the next nonlinear,
pressure, exterior, scale, cyclic, storage, joint-composition, or realization
refinement.
\end{enumerate}
Iterating these refinements computes the decreasing Navier--Stokes
circulation core.  At every depth the target-aligned branch-and-bound returns
a finite rational cylinder cover, certified price bounds, and checked
identities for all deleted cells; its interval outputs converge to the exact
range of every generated Navier--Stokes target observable.  By
\cref{thm:circulation-elimination-completeness}, that core is empty if and
only if it contains no Navier--Stokes prospective source atom.  On a
contact-generated ordinary branch every fixed atom is a hypothetical
source-profile witness and is passed to the canonical target-orbit rows.
Every finite joint-prefix
component and every nonordinary realization value is reinserted as a proper
successor before this orbit test.  Thus the specialization evaluates the
target spine by the framework transition rules and leaves no formal spine or
raw-path condition as an output.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
The specialization commutation theorem identifies the abstract layered and recurrent edge spaces,
target return, physical valuation, ordered cone, and descent defects with
their Navier--Stokes counterparts.  Apply
\cref{thm:ns-unnormalized-horizon-compiler} before
\cref{thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion}.  On the resulting primal--polar fixed
cell apply \cref{thm:target-current-circulation-duality} to obtain
\eqref{eq:ns-sharp-cycle-price}.  The six first-failure cells of
\cref{def:ns-collapsed-successor-cells} are precisely the projected total-
graph refinements in the zero-price case.  Apply
\cref{def:circulation-elimination-operator,%
def:target-aligned-structural-branch-bound,%
thm:stagewise-target-core-computation,%
thm:circulation-elimination-completeness} to their successive supports.
\end{proof}

\begin{definition}[Finite Navier--Stokes target program]
\label{def:ns-finite-target-program}
Fix a rational physical stratum \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\) and an
algebraically reachable signature \(\mathfrak b\).  At depth \(n\),
first compute \(\mathsf M^n_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) by the two graph
searches of \cref{def:ns-minimal-target-realization}.  Then
let \(\mathcal A_{{\rm NS},n}(\mathfrak b)\) be the rational cylinder algebra
generated by the retained members of the first \(n\) coordinates in the
following fixed order:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(T\arabic*)}]
\item the shell current, unnormalized prefix cocycles
\(A_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,k}=k\) for \(k\le n\), five source pairings, source
support, realization mode, same-origin rows, and the physical inequalities
\eqref{eq:ns-rational-physical-stratum};
\item the weak momentum equation, incompressibility, and rational
localizations through cylinder index \(n\);
\item the local, harmonic, exterior, and gauge-fixed pressure graphs;
\item the scale, center, moving-microscope, signed carrier, overlap, and
physical-price graphs;
\item the adjoint words in
\(\mathscr C^{n,\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\), the polarized nonlinear defects,
the first \(n\) carrier-cone membership rows and separating covectors from
\eqref{eq:ns-target-local-carrier-cone}--\eqref{eq:ns-carrier-polar-separator},
all mixed coordinates generated by the cumulative join of the first \(n\)
successor records,
the compressed Hamiltonian/resolvent matrix elements
\eqref{eq:ns-target-active-resolvent}--
\eqref{eq:ns-resolvent-source-factorization}, and the generated production words in
\(\mathscr P_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\) through index \(n\); and
\item the first \(n\) signed-dyadic return, total-graph boundary, circulation,
prior-zero, cumulative-joint, and joint-reprojection relations, followed,
whenever all preceding rows are resolved, by the first \(n\) rows of the ordinary-orbit realization relation in
\cref{def:ns-ordinary-orbit-realization-gate}.
\end{enumerate}
Partition these coordinates into rational boxes of canonical diameter at
most \(2^{-n}\).  For a box \(C\), the finite target program first introduces,
for every \(N\le n\), positive layer-edge moment functionals
\(L^{N}_{C,0},\ldots,L^{N}_{C,N-1}\) with unit mass, adjacent marginal
agreement, the same-origin relations, and the first \(n\) ordered graph rows.
It minimizes
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-finite-horizon-program-objective}
 \underline\Delta_{{\rm NS},n}^{N}(C)
 :=\inf\sum_{j<N}L^N_{C,j}(p_{{\rm NS},n}).
\end{equation}
The dual is the layered potential system in
\eqref{eq:ns-unnormalized-horizon-dual}.  A value greater than \(E\) deletes
the box before circulation normalization.

For every remaining canonical source owner, the program next tests membership
in the truncated cone \(\mathscr D_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b,n}^{\Phys}\).
A membership identity is appended to the cumulative physical ledger.  A
strict dual separator is appended with all adjoint and polarization rows in
\textup{(T5)}, after which the box is rejoined and reprojected.  Circulation
variables are introduced only when every owner visible through depth \(n\)
is fixed under this primal--polar step.

On every remaining box, the program has variables the moments of a positive
edge functional \(L_C\) on monomials of degree at most \(2n\).  It imposes
\begin{align}
 0\le L_C(1)&\le5,
 &L_C(a_{{\rm NS},\Sigma})&=1,
 \label{eq:ns-finite-program-normalization}\\
 L_C(f\circ\pi_-)&=L_C(f\circ\pi_+)
 &&(f\in\mathcal A_{{\rm NS},n-1}),
 \label{eq:ns-finite-program-circulation}\\
 L_C(I_{{\rm NS},n})&=0,
 &L_C(M_{{\rm NS},n})&\ge0,
 \label{eq:ns-finite-program-order}
\end{align}
together with the localizing matrices for \(C\).  Here
\(I_{{\rm NS},n}\) contains precisely the incidence-retained truncated rows in
\textup{(T1)}--\textup{(T6)}, while \(M_{{\rm NS},n}\) contains their
generated squares, nonnegative viscous and suitable-energy productions,
positive Reynolds polarizations, and admitted exterior productions.  The
normalization \(L_C(a_{{\rm NS},\Sigma})=1\) applies only to the compact
circulation selector.  The separate equations
\(A_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,k}=k\) retain cumulative target progress and are never
divided by \(k\).
The
objective is
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-finite-program-objective}
 \underline\delta_{{\rm NS},n}(C)
 :=\inf L_C(p_{{\rm NS},n}).
\end{equation}
Its dual variables are coefficients of the same finite equation and
positivity rows together with a cylinder potential
\(V_n\circ\pi_- -V_n\circ\pi_+\).  All variables and constraints are
generated from \textup{(B1)}--\textup{(B5)}.  The integer \(n\) is a
refinement index and has no place in the physical energy identity
\eqref{eq:ns-single-physical-budget}.  At finite depth the realization row
contains only its first \(n\) rational cylinder and continuation-graph
relations.  Membership in the full ordinary range is decided only by the
joint-saturated diagonal realization row of
\cref{def:ns-ordinary-orbit-realization-gate}; it is never inserted as a
finite scalar constraint, and ordinary realization alone does not terminate
the program.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Complete finite-stage Navier--Stokes evaluation]
\label{thm:ns-finite-stage-target-evaluation}
Fix rational \(E>0\).  Apply \cref{def:ns-finite-target-program}
simultaneously to every algebraically reachable signature in
\(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\) whose defining prefix occurs among the first
\(n\) generated coordinates, and retain only the target-visible boxes.  There
are finitely many such prefixes at each depth.
At depth \(n\), delete a box carrying a finite-horizon dual identity above
\(E\), a finite infeasibility identity, or a strictly positive cycle-price
identity.  Before cycle-price evaluation, process every owner by the finite
carrier-cone membership/separation problem: a charging identity updates the
ledger and a separating covector creates the next dual successor.  Rejoin
every other box with its
complete parent prefix, generate the mixed coordinates, reproject, and refine
at its least unprocessed coordinate in the order \textup{(T1)}--\textup{(T6)}.  A
nonordinary realization value is replaced by its proper successor box before
the next depth.  Let
\(\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}\) be the resulting compact finite union; its
dependence on \(E\) is suppressed.  Then:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(E\arabic*)}]
\item the calculation at depth \(n\) is finite and exact; it returns
\(\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}\), the feasible moment sets, rational lower
cumulative horizon and recurrent cycle prices, and a checked ordered
identity for every deleted box;
\item the covers decrease and satisfy
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-computed-target-core}
 \bigcap_{n\ge0}\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}
 =\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},\infty},
 \qquad
 \mathscr U_{{\rm NS},\infty}
 =\bigsqcup_{\mathfrak b\in\mathfrak B_{\rm NS}^{\rm reach}(E)}
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\!\left(
 X_{\infty,\mathfrak b}\cap
 \lvert\mathsf M_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\rvert
 \right);
 \end{equation}
this is the graph-complete recursive state space before the canonical-orbit
rows, not a terminal singular set.  Its joint fixed-point image consists of
formal source-profile atoms which are passed to
\cref{def:ns-contact-realizable-target-cover}; every finite
joint-prefix increment that is not already source-resolved, every
carrier--polar separator, and every
nonordinary realization value, has an outgoing edge to its typed successor
signature;
\item if \(\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}=\varnothing\) at a finite depth, the
attached identities concatenate to a finite derivation of
\(\Reach_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}^{\Phys}(E)=0\) on the declared physical stratum;
if all depths are nonempty, every infinite compatible box word is joined and
reprojected.  A least unprocessed limiting target increment is exposed on a
finite joint prefix and becomes its proper successor.  Processed increments,
however small, remain in the cumulative record.  A word becomes a
source-profile output when its cumulative record is a primal--polar fixed
structural atom.  That output is passed to the canonical same-origin orbit
rows before any PDE conclusion is drawn.  It retains complete moments,
graphs, source projections, unnormalized shell cocycle, origin rows, and
shell rows;
\item for every generated bounded continuous Navier--Stokes target
observable \(F\), the finite programs compute nested rational intervals
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-target-observable-enclosures}
 I_{{\rm NS},n}(F)\downarrow
 \left[
 \min_{\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},\infty}}F,
 \max_{\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},\infty}}F
 \right].
\end{equation}
In particular, pressure-tail mass, scale cohomology, Reynolds-defect mass,
viscous production, shell alignment, and every generated commutator
production are evaluated by two-sided structural enclosures on the surviving
target core.
\end{enumerate}
No analytic property is tested outside the target spine.  A failed
compactness, pressure, tail, chart, product, or realization relation changes
the next box coordinate and is processed by the same finite program.
Running the construction over the countable cofinal family
\(E\in\mathbb Q_{>0}\) covers the entire smooth finite-energy datum class.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
The rows in \textup{(T1)}--\textup{(T6)} are the Navier--Stokes images of the
abstract target-spine enumeration.  Their finite moment and localizing
conditions, including the rational energy ceiling \(E\), are rational
semialgebraic conditions.  Origin evaluations and weak integrals are moment
variables constrained by graph rows rather than scalar coefficients.  Exact elimination
decides finite feasibility and checks the dual identities.  The layered
marginal rows and their objective are
\eqref{eq:ns-finite-horizon-program-objective}; their dual is
\eqref{eq:ns-unnormalized-horizon-dual}.  The circulation
normalization and coboundary rows are
\eqref{eq:target-current-circulation-constraints}; the objective and its
dual are \eqref{eq:ns-sharp-cycle-price}.  This proves \textup{(E1)}.

The specialization homomorphism preserves the target quotient, physical
valuation, ordered cone, source ancestry, edge marginals, and the least
unprocessed total graph, as well as cumulative joining and joint target
projection.  Hence it maps the abstract branch-and-bound cover
at every depth onto \(\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}\).  Apply
\cref{thm:stagewise-target-core-computation} and commute intersections of
the decreasing compact covers with this graph-complete specialization to
obtain \eqref{eq:ns-computed-target-core}.
Before the realization row, apply
\cref{thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion} to every cumulative owner; a nonzero
separator is a proper successor already included among the reachable
signatures.  On the primal--polar fixed cell, apply
\cref{thm:ns-realization-gate-alternative}.  Its nonordinary value is a
proper successor already included among the reachable signatures.  Its
ordinary contacting value is rejoined and reprojected; the finite-prefix
case is another proper successor.  The fixed case is the source-profile
output passed to the canonical-orbit extension below.

Compactness makes an empty limiting core empty at a finite depth; summing the
finitely many attached identities proves \textup{(E3)}.  In the nonempty
case, the least-coordinate refinement resolves every public operation and
retains every same-origin shell row and every value of the unnormalized
cocycle.  Forming the cumulative join and applying
\cref{thm:continuum-composition-no-creation} exposes every limiting target
component at a finite prefix.  Every failed realization and every polar
separator is reindexed as a proper successor.  A primal--polar fixed joint
atom is the source-profile output passed to the canonical-orbit extension.
Finally,
uniform rational cylinder approximation and
monotonicity of extrema on decreasing compact sets give
\eqref{eq:ns-target-observable-enclosures}.  Every observable listed in
\textup{(E4)} is a generated cylinder coordinate or a monotone limit of such
coordinates.
\end{proof}

\subsubsection{Terminal execution of the Navier--Stokes target program}

The terminal step retains the unnormalized shell cocycle.  It is the
continuum counterpart of cumulative prospective accountability in Part~I:
finite source occurrences are evaluated through their complete prefix
current, never through their average.

Fix a nonnegative rational cutoff \(\zeta\in C_c^\infty(B_2)\), equal to one
on \(B_1\), and define the generated Galilean quotient observable
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-quotient-activity}
 \mathcal O_\zeta(V;I)
 :=\int_I\int_{B_2}\zeta^3
   \lvert V-\bar V_\zeta\rvert^3\,\dd y\dd\tau,
 \qquad
 \bar V_\zeta
 :=\frac{\int\zeta^2V\,\dd y}{\int\zeta^2\,\dd y}.
\end{equation}
The observable is adjoined through its total graph and rational polarity
cells.  A positive rational floor is available only on a cofinal cell on
which a finite target-local ordered identity derives it from the
continuation-shell record.  The complementary cell includes both an exact
zero and a positive sequence tending to zero; it remains a target-visible
vanishing-activity successor with the full unnormalized shell cocycle unless
a separate generated identity makes it target-null.  In particular, local
smallness is not identified with continuation by definition.

\begin{theorem}[Canonical shell-selected microscope record]
\label{thm:ns-canonical-target-orbit}
If a maximal strong branch in \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\) contacts
\(\Sigma_{\rm sing}\) at \(T_*<\infty\), the target program constructs one
absolutely continuous parabolic chart \((X,\Lambda)\), one normalized orbit
\((V,P,a,b)(\tau)\), and pairwise disjoint unit intervals \(I_j\) such that:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(C\arabic*)}]
\item \(\Lambda(\tau_j)\downarrow0\), the physical images approach \(T_*\),
and all charts are exact pullbacks of the same physical orbit;
\item every interval carries the exact normalized continuation-shell
increment one.  On each positive quotient-activity cell there is a rational
\(\eta_0>0\) for which
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-canonical-target-floor}
 \mathcal O_\zeta(V;I_j)\ge\eta_0\qquad(j\ge1);
\end{equation}
  holds; otherwise a cofinal subsequence has
  \(\mathcal O_\zeta(V;I_j)\to0\), and its quotient numerator, shell
  multiplicity, physical denominator, and complete five-source current are
  retained as the vanishing-activity total-graph successor.  Neither value is
  called regular;
\item on each rational cylinder, either the generated
\(L^\infty_\tau L^2_y\), \(L^2_\tau H^1_y\), \(L^3\)-velocity, and
gauge-fixed \(L^{3/2}\)-pressure coordinates are bounded along the selected
subsequence and its closure has
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-canonical-strong-compactness}
 V_k\to V\ \hbox{ strongly in }L^3_{\rm loc},
 \qquad P_k\to P\ \hbox{ strongly in }L^{3/2}_{\rm loc},
\end{equation}
or the least unbounded or failed equation, amplitude, product, pressure, tail,
chart, defect, or realization coordinate produces its typed target-active
successor;
\item endpoint traces, signed currents, physical expenditure, the target
floor, and the unnormalized shell cocycle obey the chart composition law.
\end{enumerate}
Every first failure in \textup{(C3)} is re-entered at its first visible
parabolic scale with its complete same-origin prefix.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Choose the least dyadic cylinder on which the generated continuation-shell
observable crosses its next normalized shell.  This uses the shell identity,
not an \(L^3\) regularity threshold.  Repeat chronologically and pass once to
a subsequence.  Apply the cofinal dichotomy to the nonnegative sequence
\(\mathcal O_\zeta(V;I_j)\): either some rational \(\eta_0>0\) is exceeded
infinitely often, in which case restrict to that subsequence, or a cofinal
subsequence tends to zero.  In the second case retain the activity numerator,
the unit shell cocycle, every physical denominator, the source owners, and
the total activity graph as the successor stated in \textup{(C2)}.  Thus a
sequence of positive subthreshold contributions is neither identified with
the zero function nor discarded.

Interpolate the selected centers and logarithmic scales through the inactive
normalized intervals.  This gives \(\dot t=\Lambda^2\),
\(a=\dot\Lambda/\Lambda\), \(b=\dot X/\Lambda\), and exact composition.
On the bounded coordinate cell, the moving equation bounds
\(\partial_\tau V\) in
\(L^{4/3}_\tau W^{-1,3/2}_y\).  Spatial Rellich compactness and the resulting
time-translation estimate give strong local \(L^2\) convergence;
interpolation with the energy-bound \(L^{10/3}_{\rm loc}\) norm gives strong
\(L^3_{\rm loc}\) convergence.  The local Calder\'on--Zygmund pressure then
converges strongly in \(L^{3/2}_{\rm loc}\).  The harmonic remainder is
compact after its constant gauge is removed; its first noncompact Taylor or
exterior coordinate is the corresponding typed successor.  The ordered
total-graph construction treats every other failure identically.  Strong
\(L^3\) convergence preserves \eqref{eq:ns-canonical-target-floor}, and the
common physical origin proves \textup{(C4)}.  If any displayed bound diverges,
its first rational superlevel is the amplitude or pressure successor stated in
\textup{(C3)}; no scale-uniform bound is inferred from kinetic energy.
\end{proof}

\begin{lemma}[Computed target-visible critical price schedule]
\label{lem:ns-computed-critical-price}
For each interval in a positive quotient-activity cell of
\cref{thm:ns-canonical-target-orbit}, put
\[
 M_{2,j}:=\|V\|_{L^\infty(I_j;L^2(B_2))}.
\]
On the finite \(M_{2,j}\) cell, the generated price is
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-computed-critical-price}
 D_j^{\rm act}:=\nu\int_{I_j}\int_{B_2}
 \zeta^2|\nabla V|^2\,\dd y\dd\tau
 \ge d_j
 :=\nu\left(\frac{\eta_0}
 {C_\zeta M_{2,j}^{3/2}}\right)^{4/3}.
\end{equation}
The vanishing-activity cell has no positive price conclusion from this
lemma and returns to its target-visible activity successor with its cumulative
shell ledger.  The complementary
value \(M_{2,j}=+\infty\), and a sequence with
\(M_{2,j}\to\infty\), enter the target-visible amplitude successor with the
original physical scale and shell cocycle retained.  No uniform positive
lower bound for \(d_j\) is asserted.
\end{lemma}

\begin{proof}
Weighted Poincar\'e--Sobolev on the connected support of \(\zeta\), followed
by \(L^2\)--\(L^6\) interpolation, gives
\[
 \|\zeta(V-\bar V_\zeta)\|_3^3
 \le C_\zeta\|V\|_{L^2(B_2)}^{3/2}
       \|\zeta\nabla V\|_2^{3/2}.
\]
Integrate on the unit interval and use H\"older and
\eqref{eq:ns-canonical-target-floor} to obtain
\eqref{eq:ns-computed-critical-price}.
The calculation occurs on the selected target quotient.  Its equality
kernel consists of spatial constants and is therefore target-null.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Five-source cumulative-current rebasing]
\label{thm:ns-cumulative-current-rebasing}
Let \(C_j\) be consecutive half-open cells of the canonical orbit, including
the inactive interval between consecutive target windows, and let \(H_j\) be
their complete signed \(\Geom/\Caus/\Abs/\Lift/\Bdry\) current.  Then
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-terminal-financing}
 \sum_{j<N}(D_j+M_j)
 =K_0^- -K_{N-1}^++\sum_{j<N}H_j,
 \qquad D_j\ge D_j^{\rm act}.
\end{equation}
Every persistent current has
exactly one of these outputs:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(R\arabic*)}]
\item its least nonordinary equation, nonlinear, pressure, exterior, chart,
defect, trace, or realization coordinate is rebased at its first visible
scale as the corresponding five-source successor;
\item a bounded logarithmic support cell retains
\(\mathcal O_\zeta\ge\eta_0\) and becomes the next same-origin observer
record;
\item the cumulative graph-complete join has a nonzero logarithmic tail with
complete source, pressure, defect, chart, origin-polarity, and
unnormalized-cocycle marks.  It is a relaxed prospective tail until the
approximation--orbit realization gate is passed.
\end{enumerate}
An infinite sequence of \textup{(R1)}--\textup{(R2)} rebases has a cofinal
cumulative joint limit.  That limit has a least unprocessed finite coordinate
or the relaxed tail value \textup{(R3)}.  Neither value is a singular terminal.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Sum the compatible signed carrier identities before taking positive parts.
Internal faces cancel and endpoint storage telescopes, proving
\eqref{eq:ns-terminal-financing}.  The schedule in
\cref{lem:ns-computed-critical-price} is retained term by term.  If
\(\sum_jd_j=\infty\), the left side diverges and the signed supply must
finance that divergence.  If \(\sum_jd_j<\infty\), the complete sequence
\((M_{2,j},d_j,r_j)\) is attached to the amplitude/scale successor.  These
values exhaust the schedule and no constant price is inserted.

Put the positive part of each remaining oriented current on the logarithmic
scale interval traversed by its cell, retaining its five-source owner and
complete same-origin record.  One owner carries a fixed fraction of the
persistent mass.  Its least failed coordinate on the rational cylinder
exhaustion gives \textup{(R1)}.  Otherwise the marked measures are tight.
Target-active support gives \textup{(R2)}.  Passing to the graph-complete
limit gives the relaxed tail in \textup{(R3)}; it does not assert that every
support point is one ordinary PDE state.
For cofinal blocks the unnormalized shell cocycle equals the number of
crossings and is never divided by that number.  Tight blocks yield the
graph-complete value \textup{(R3)}.  Nontight blocks have a first rational
tail coordinate; rebasing at its first visible scale gives \textup{(R1)}, and
a cofinal diagonal join retains all earlier marks.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Exhaustive critical-tail accounting]
\label{thm:ns-critical-tail-nullity}
Recursively process every logarithmic tail produced by
\cref{thm:ns-cumulative-current-rebasing}, always adjoining the least
unprocessed typed coordinate to its complete marked transcript.  A finite
first failure returns to \textup{(R1)}.  An infinite chain has a diagonal
marked tail on which every generated coordinate has been processed.  On its
same-origin occurrence space that tail has the physical Lebesgue
decomposition
\[
 \Gamma_\Sigma=f_\Sigma\mu_{\Phys}+\Gamma_\Sigma^\perp
\]
of \cref{thm:exact-compositional-physical-accounting}.  It is therefore
target-null, has finite physical amplification, has unbounded source-owned
amplification, or has a nonzero source-owned physical-singular part.  These
four cells exhaust diffuse, concentrated, nonlinear-defect, pressure-tail,
homogeneous, log-periodic, and aperiodic coherent tails.  The last two are
target-visible prospective successors; they are singular terminals only on
the independent ordinary-realization fiber.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Decompose into dyadic logarithmic shells.  Failure of logarithmic tightness
has a first nonzero tail coordinate and gives \textup{(R1)}; a failed chart,
pressure, trace, product, domain, compactness, or realization coordinate is
also \textup{(R1)}.  On the complementary total-graph cell, ordinary strong
product and pressure values are used only when their graph coordinates are
ordinary.  Oscillation, Reynolds concentration, harmonic pressure, exterior
remainder, and all failures of strong local convergence retain their own
typed coordinates.  Thus no local-energy bound is promoted to strong
\(L^2_{\rm loc}\) or \(L^3_{\rm loc}\) compactness.  Put the resulting
diffuse, concentrated, and coherent components and their
completed crossings and intervening gaps on the occurrence space of
\cref{def:same-origin-occurrence-measure}.  Signed gluing gives the exact
five-source numerator and restriction of the original kinetic-energy carrier
gives \(\mu_{\Phys}\).  The unique decomposition of
\cref{thm:exact-compositional-physical-accounting} gives the four listed
cells.  No bounded full-cylinder representative, strong tail compactness, or
scale summability is inferred.

Fix the countable order of rational equation tests, product polarizations,
pressure and tail coefficients, chart and trace graphs, defect tests, shell
observables, and realization rows used by the target program.  A return to
\textup{(R1)} appends the least coordinate not already ordinary or
discharged, so it cannot repeat the same finite transcript.  From an infinite
chain choose the diagonal marked tail whose first \(n\) coordinates agree
with the chain after stage \(n\).  The expanded join retains every earlier
source owner and the unnormalized cocycle.  Every finite coordinate is now
ordinary or discharged, so none of the first-failure alternatives in the
preceding paragraphs remains.  The same measure decomposition applies to the
diagonal tail and is invariant under further refinement by
\cref{cor:composition-refinement-scale-covariance}.  A null numerator is
target-null; an absolutely continuous numerator has its exact amplification
density; and a singular numerator retains the five-source owner of its
detecting word.  These alternatives exhaust all five-source support and
boundary coordinates without assuming the terminal value.
\end{proof}

\begin{definition}[Prospective positive-floor Navier--Stokes cover]
\label{def:ns-contact-realizable-target-cover}
Let \(\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}^{\rm orb}(E)\) be the closed subcover of
\(\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}(E)\) obtained by adjoining the first \(n\) rational
rows of the canonical same-origin orbit, the quotient floor
\eqref{eq:ns-canonical-target-floor}, the computed critical-price identity,
the signed financing identity \eqref{eq:ns-terminal-financing}, and the first
\(n\) marked first-scale rebasing and tail-discharge rows.  Put
\[
 \mathscr U_{{\rm NS},\infty}^{\rm orb}(E)
 :=\bigcap_n\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}^{\rm orb}(E).
\]
This is the positive-floor prospective fiber of the target program.  It
does not contain the complementary vanishing-activity successor and is not the
full contact set.  Formal positive functionals without a Dirac same-origin
row remain relaxed states; contact-derived rows retain hypothetical origin.
Physical PDE contact is obtained only through the ordinary independent
realization criterion.
\end{definition}

\begin{proposition}[Finite-amplitude Navier--Stokes amplification tangents are target-null]
\label{prop:ns-ordinary-amplification-tangent-nullity}
Let \(L\) be the target-normalized tangent of an unbounded or
physical-singular Navier--Stokes source amplification.  Fix a rational
compact cylinder \(B_2\times I\) and the quotient activity
\eqref{eq:ns-quotient-activity}.  If the generated amplitude graph has an
ordinary finite bound
\[
 \|V\|_{L^\infty(I;L^2(B_2))}\le M<\infty,
\]
then the ordered zero-production relations imply
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-zero-production-quotient-nullity}
 L\bigl(\mathcal O_\zeta(V;I)\bigr)=0.
\end{equation}
This conclusion holds for graph-complete positive functionals and does not
require ordinary realization of \(L\).  Hence a tangent retaining a positive
quotient-activity floor must have an unbounded or nonordinary amplitude graph,
which is the next typed amplitude/scale successor.  If, in addition, all
equation and realization coordinates are ordinary, the represented velocity
is spatially constant on each connected cylinder and is Galilean-null.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
Choose a nonnegative rational cutoff \(\chi\) equal to one on
\(\operatorname{supp}\zeta\) and compactly supported in \(B_2\).  The
localized viscous production
\[
 P_\chi(V)=\nu\int\chi^2|\nabla V|^2
\]
belongs to \(\mathscr P_{\mathfrak b}^{\Phys}\).  By
\cref{thm:amplification-zero-production-tangent}, \(L(P_\chi)=0\).
The weighted Poincar\'e--Sobolev relation used in
\cref{lem:ns-computed-critical-price} is a generated ordered-algebra row.
After raising it to the fourth power and using the amplitude bound, it gives
the bounded nonnegative cylinder relation
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-ordered-activity-production-domination}
 \mathcal O_\zeta(V;I)^4
 \le C_{\zeta,\nu}M^6P_\chi(V)^3.
\end{equation}
All quantities in this relation are total-graph generators on the selected
finite-amplitude cell.  Apply
\cref{thm:dyadic-ordered-coercivity-terminal-rule} with
\(A=\mathcal O_\zeta\), \(P=P_\chi\), the amplitude coordinate as \(M\),
and \((k,a,b)=(2,6,3)\).  It gives
\eqref{eq:ns-zero-production-quotient-nullity}.  A positive activity floor is
therefore incompatible with finite amplitude before any ordinary realization
test is applied.

On the ordinary realization fiber, \(L(P_\chi)=0\) for every such cutoff
gives \(\nabla V=0\) almost everywhere.  Connectedness and overlap
compatibility give \(V(y,\tau)=c(\tau)\), and the Galilean quotient subtracts
this spatial constant.
\end{proof}

\begin{proposition}[Navier--Stokes covariant-corona transitions]
\label{prop:ns-complete-covariant-corona-execution}
On every target-visible Navier--Stokes corona, specialize
\cref{def:evaluated-covariant-corona-record} by taking
\[
 K=K_\phi,\qquad
 \dd\mathsf D=D_\phi\,\dd\tau+\dd M_\phi,
 \qquad \kappa=-1,
\]
and, with \(Y_\phi:=\int e\,y\cdot\nabla\phi\), put
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-evaluated-corona-remainder}
 \dd\mathsf R_\phi
 :=\bigl(F_{\rm int,\phi}+F_{\rm tr,\phi}-aY_\phi\bigr)\,\dd\tau .
\end{equation}
Indeed \(F_{\rm sc,\phi}=-aK_\phi-aY_\phi\), so
\eqref{eq:ns-covariant-carrier-identity} is exactly
\eqref{eq:evaluated-corona-carrier-row} with these values.  The resulting
finite-prefix weight and production are therefore
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-explicit-corona-weight}
 \theta_I(\tau)
 =r(\tau)\int_\tau^{\tau_+}\frac{\dd s}{r(s)},
 \qquad
 \dd\mathcal P_{{\rm NS},I}
 =K_\phi\,\dd\tau
  +\theta_I\bigl(D_\phi\,\dd\tau+\dd M_\phi\bigr).
\end{equation}
These quantities are determined by the same physical orbit and microscope;
they introduce neither a second budget nor a freely chosen multiplier.  The
execution has exactly these evaluation values:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(N\arabic*)}]
\item cumulative signed gluing produces
  \eqref{eq:covariant-cumulative-financing}, and the same finite-prefix
  carrier identities derive a prefix-independent ceiling for the target
  pairing of its weighted root, physical, and exterior terms, giving finite
  carrier exclusion;
\item the covariant production vanishes.  Every finite-amplitude graph state
  is target-null by
  \cref{prop:ns-ordinary-amplification-tangent-nullity};
\item a same-origin Navier--Stokes corona produces a target-visible unbounded
  weighted-root financing coordinate or the separator
  \eqref{eq:evaluated-singular-corona-separator}, with its first
  target-visible scale, pressure, exterior, trace, concentration, or
  realization coordinate and all subsequent primal--polar descendants.
\end{enumerate}
Thus the Navier--Stokes example performs the covariant-corona transition
calculation.  The third cell is an internal successor.  It proves neither
regularity nor singular existence until carrier--polar recursion and the
independent approximation-realization test return one of the two sound
terminal types in \cref{cor:binary-continuum-terminal-theorem}.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
The moving equation is \eqref{eq:ns-moving-frame-equation}.  Testing it by
\(V\phi\) gives \eqref{eq:ns-covariant-carrier-identity}; oriented
parent--child summation gives \eqref{eq:ns-scale-cell-gluing}.  These are
exactly the carrier row, signed gluing, and scale exponent required by
\cref{def:evaluated-covariant-corona-record}, because splitting
\(F_{\rm sc,\phi}=-aK_\phi-aY_\phi\) gives \(\kappa=-1\) and
\eqref{eq:ns-evaluated-corona-remainder}.  Since \(a=\dot r/r\), the
integrating factor in \eqref{eq:evaluated-corona-integrating-factor} is
\(m_I(\tau)=r(\tau_-)/r(\tau)\), which proves
\eqref{eq:ns-explicit-corona-weight}.  The record-scale selector has
\(a\le0\), but the adjoint construction does not use that sign.
\Cref{thm:complete-covariant-corona-evaluator} therefore gives the three
listed values.  In the first value, prefix-independent finiteness is not
assumed: it is exactly the additional ordered inequality required by
\textup{(V1)}; failure of that inequality is the least unbounded financing
coordinate in \textup{(N3)}.  Its equality value is
\cref{prop:ns-ordinary-amplification-tangent-nullity}; its strict-separation
value retains the hypothetical contact origin by construction and therefore
re-enters the successor calculus.  No additional Navier--Stokes hypothesis is
introduced.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Necessary Navier--Stokes contact amplification]
\label{thm:ns-empty-singular-target-core}
For every rational \(E>0\), every same-origin contact record satisfies
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-empty-singular-target-core}
 \Gamma_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}^\perp\ne0
 \quad\hbox{or}\quad
 \operatorname*{ess\,sup}_{\mu_{\Phys}}f_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}=\infty .
\end{equation}
The target program selects the first nonzero five-source component of
\(\Gamma_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}^\perp\), or a cofinal sequence of five-source
amplification cells on which \(f_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}\to\infty\).
\Cref{thm:prospective-source-amplification-extraction} selects one fixed
channel and finite pre-contact events satisfying
\eqref{eq:sourcewise-unbounded-amplification} or
\eqref{eq:sourcewise-singular-target-mass}.  Target normalization then
produces the zero-production tangent of
\cref{thm:amplification-zero-production-tangent}.  Its ordinary
Navier--Stokes realization is target-null by
\cref{prop:ns-ordinary-amplification-tangent-nullity}; otherwise its least
nonordinary scale, pressure, exterior, trace, concentration, or realization
coordinate enters the successor closure of
\cref{thm:closed-amplification-successor-terminalization}.  A cofinal chain
therefore returns a same-origin five-source prospective corona record and
re-enters carrier--polar and realization evaluation.  Cofinality alone is not
a singular-existence terminal.
The carrier and separator attached to that record are evaluated by
\cref{prop:ns-complete-covariant-corona-execution}.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Contact produces the cumulative same-origin shell record.  Intersect its
physical events into disjoint incidence atoms and apply
\cref{thm:exact-compositional-physical-accounting}.  The kinetic-energy
inequality makes \(\mu_{\Phys}\) finite.  A contact record has infinitely many
crossings, so \eqref{eq:finite-budget-amplification-alternative} proves
\eqref{eq:ns-empty-singular-target-core}.  Source-resolved occurrence
accounting assigns the amplification to the five inherited channels.  No
converse reachability assertion follows from this measure decomposition.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Localization of the surviving Navier--Stokes terminal cell]
\label{cor:ns-surviving-amplitude-scale-cell}
On the positive quotient-activity fiber of a same-origin contact record, every
zero-production amplification tangent is excluded unless, along a cofinal
family of its rational cylinders,
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-surviving-amplitude-scale-cell}
 r_j\longrightarrow0,
 \qquad
 M_{2,j}:=\|V_j\|_{L^\infty(I_j;L^2(B_2))}\longrightarrow\infty
\end{equation}
or the amplitude graph has a nonordinary value.  The value in
\eqref{eq:ns-surviving-amplitude-scale-cell} retains the joint coordinates
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-surviving-amplitude-scale-joint-record}
 \left(
 r_j, M_{2,j}, D_j, M_j, r_j(D_j+M_j),
 \mathcal O_\zeta(V_j;I_j), Q_{\Sigma,j}, \Anc_j
 \right)
\end{equation}
before any normalization or subsequence operation.  In particular, neither
the amplitude divergence nor the scale collapse is a terminal by itself.

No scale-independent domination of \(D_j+M_j\) by the physical price
\(r_j(D_j+M_j)\) follows from the public energy carrier on this cell.  Any
terminal exclusion of \eqref{eq:ns-surviving-amplitude-scale-cell} must
therefore generate an additional scale-critical carrier identity from the
Navier--Stokes equation; it cannot be obtained by dividing the existing
physical ledger by \(r_j\).
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
If the scales have a positive lower bound, the fixed-scale closure lemma makes
every zero-production component target-null.  On collapsing scales, suppose
that \(M_{2,j}\) is bounded on a cofinal family and that its graph value is
ordinary.  Apply
\cref{prop:ns-ordinary-amplification-tangent-nullity} on that family.  It
annihilates the positive quotient-activity floor, a contradiction.  The
remaining cofinal value is exactly
\eqref{eq:ns-surviving-amplitude-scale-cell}; cumulative-joint saturation
retains every coordinate in
\eqref{eq:ns-surviving-amplitude-scale-joint-record}.

Finally, \cref{lem:ns-scale-collapse-degeneracy} constructs, for arbitrary
normalized dissipation values \(d_j\), scales \(r_j\downarrow0\) for which
\(r_jd_j\to0\).  Hence the asserted scale-independent domination is not a
consequence of the existing carrier relation.  This proves both the
localization and the prohibition on an ungenerated division by scale.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Navier--Stokes prospective outputs of the continuum compiler]
\label{cor:ns-continuum-compiler-closure}
For every rational \(E>0\), applying the continuum compiler to the public
unforced Navier--Stokes presentation on \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\) constructs
the two sides of \eqref{eq:target-progress-lebesgue-decomposition} on each
same-origin contact record.  The bounded absolutely-continuous identity
\eqref{eq:compositional-regularity-test}, when derived by the ordered carrier
calculus on every reachable contact cell, excludes contact.  Its complementary
amplification and physical-singular values are prospective five-source
successors.  They are not singular-existence terminals without the independent
ordinary realization required by \cref{def:explicit-singular-mechanism}.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
Apply \cref{thm:ns-empty-singular-target-core} and
\cref{cor:composition-refinement-scale-covariance}.
\end{proof}

\begin{definition}[Target-retaining Navier--Stokes carrier complex]
\label{def:ns-target-carrier-complex}
Generate the continuation target from failure of the declared strong class.
Restrict the canonical parabolic chart tree to descendants with positive
pairing against the singular-shell family \(\Gamma_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}\).
Equivalently, take its current projection from
\(\mathsf M_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\); typed frontier and graph-boundary
edges are retained until their pairings are resolved.
On each cell use the local kinetic-energy identity and the pressure split
\[
 -\Delta p=\partial_i\partial_j(u_i u_j)
\]
with local singular-integral, harmonic-gauge, and exterior-tail graph
coordinates.  Sum cell identities with their orientations before taking
positive parts.  The remaining scale current defines
\[
 [F_{\rm sc}^{\rm NS}]
 \in
 \frac{\overline{\Pi_\Sigma F_{\rm sc}^{\rm NS}}}
 {\overline{\Pi_\Sigma\{\Psi-\Psi\circ S\}}}.
\]
\end{definition}

\begin{definition}[Moving-microscope successor cells]
\label{def:ns-collapsed-successor-cells}
Fix an algebraically reachable active branch \(\mathfrak b\).  Let
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}^{\rm coll}\) be the part of
\(Z_{\infty,A}^{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}\cap
X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\) satisfying
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-collapsed-kernel}
 r=0,\qquad p=0,\qquad
 \operatorname{Prog}_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}\ge\frac15,
 \qquad I_{\rm movNS}=0,
\end{equation}
together with the same-origin parabolic successor relations and the signed
carrier relation \eqref{eq:ns-scale-cell-gluing}.  Here \(r=0\) denotes the
boundary of the physical chart-scale coordinate; the normalized field and
its moving equation remain present through \(I_{\rm movNS}=0\), the ideal
generated by \eqref{eq:ns-moving-frame-equation}.  Order the total-graph
coordinates as follows:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(N\arabic*)}]
\item the normalized weak equation and incompressibility;
\item realization of \(V\otimes V\) in the nonlinear current;
\item the local pressure constraint modulo time-dependent constants;
\item the harmonic/exterior pressure and carrier-tail coordinates;
\item parabolic chart covariance, the moving-microscope equation, and the
scale-carrier cohomology relation.
\item the adjoint operator \eqref{eq:ns-adjoint-linearized-operator}, its
rational difference-quotient graph, the defect polarizations
\eqref{eq:ns-reynolds-defect-positive}--\eqref{eq:ns-defect-pressure}, and
the generated production and joint-kernel relations
\eqref{eq:ns-target-cyclic-joint-kernel}.
\end{enumerate}
The first nonordinary coordinate defines, respectively, the equation,
nonlinear-concentration, pressure, exterior-boundary, or scale-covariance
cell, followed by the target-cyclic cell.  If all six coordinates are
ordinary, the state lies in the ordinary collapsed cell.  Denote the seven
resulting cells by
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm eq}}\),
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm nl}}\),
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm pr}}\),
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm ext}}\),
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm sc}}\),
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm cyc}}\), and
\(Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm ord}}\).
\end{definition}

\begin{proposition}[Exhaustiveness of the microscope cells]
\label{prop:ns-collapsed-cell-exhaustion}
Every target-visible zero-price Navier--Stokes successor belongs to exactly
one of the seven cells in
\cref{def:ns-collapsed-successor-cells}, after its fixed-scale component has
been removed by \cref{lem:ns-fixed-scale-closure}.  Each cell retains the
complete parent signature \(\mathfrak b\) and ancestry in its support
\(A\subseteq\Channels\): nonlinear and pressure transport have \(\Caus\)
ancestry, concentration and parabolic covariance append \(\Lift\), pressure
gauge appends \(\Abs\), a nonzero exterior trace appends \(\Bdry\), and the
cyclic cell retains the union of the source words occurring in its adjoint,
commutator, defect, and production coordinate.
None is a residual source.
In the ordinary cell, every infinite target-retaining path satisfies the
scale-saturation law \eqref{eq:ns-scale-saturation-law}; a strict carrier
deficit has already been excluded by \cref{thm:ns-microscope-passivity}.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
The scale coordinate has the exhaustive closed split \(r>0\) or \(r=0\).
The first case is closed by \cref{lem:ns-fixed-scale-closure}.  On \(r=0\),
totalize the six displayed interfaces and select the first nonordinary value;
if none occurs, all values are ordinary.  This gives a disjoint exhaustive
list.  The ancestry assertions follow from
\cref{prop:ns-source-scaling-compilation,thm:source-preserving-completion}.
The target-null quotient is taken only after these tags are fixed, so a
target-visible member cannot be assigned to the residual.  If all interfaces
are ordinary, \cref{thm:ns-microscope-passivity} applies and leaves only its
saturation alternative.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Navier--Stokes target-cyclic stress test]
\label{thm:ns-target-cyclic-stress-test}
Fix rational \(E>0\).  Let
\(\mathfrak b=(A,m,\Gamma,1/5,\mathbf R)\) be an algebraically reachable
target-active signature in \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\), and let
\(\Phi\in\Gamma\).
Apply the general joint-kernel descent on
\(X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\) to
\(\mathscr C^{\infty,\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}(\Phi)\),
\(\mathscr P_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}(\Phi)\), and
\(X^\infty_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b,\Phi}\).  The specialization has the following
exhaustive outputs.
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(S\arabic*)}]
\item After target-local fact factorization and admission by
\eqref{eq:target-aligned-charge-rule}, a signed local-energy, commutator, or
defect identity charges a disjoint cofinal shell family by divergent
\(\mu_{\rm NS}\)-mass, contradicting
\eqref{eq:ns-single-physical-budget}.
\item Every restriction of
\(\mathscr C^{\infty,\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}(\Phi)\) annihilates the viscous, nonlinear,
pressure, quotient, scale, and boundary currents on
\(X^\infty_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b,\Phi}\); the shell is constant and contact is impossible.
\item The least nonordinary or nonzero descendant lies in exactly one of
\[
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm eq}},\quad
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm nl}},\quad
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm pr}},\quad
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm ext}},\quad
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm sc}},\quad
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^{\rm cyc}}.
\]
Its successor datum is respectively the equation residual, Reynolds defect,
pressure cokernel, exterior tail, nonexact scale current, or failed adjoint,
commutator, polarization, or production coordinate, always with the detecting
shell covector and original orbit tag.
\item Every finite structural coordinate and every finite cumulative-joint
projection has been processed.  The cumulative record is a fixed
moving-frame Navier--Stokes structural atom on
\(X^\infty_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b,\Phi}\), with zero generated production,
nonzero unnormalized shell cocycle, and complete source ancestry.  It is sent
to the ordinary-orbit realization row with its same-origin and cofinal-shell
rows.
\end{enumerate}
All compactness, pressure, tail, scale, and multiplier coordinates used here
are generated inside the minimal incidence realization.  The final
alternative is an internal realization state.  It is passed to the canonical
same-origin orbit and five-source cumulative-current rebasing of
\cref{thm:ns-canonical-target-orbit,thm:ns-cumulative-current-rebasing}; it is
not a terminal output.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
By \cref{prop:ns-adjoint-current-image}, the module
\eqref{eq:ns-target-cyclic-module} is the exact Navier--Stokes image of the
general cyclic module.  By \cref{prop:ns-incidence-reduction}, its restriction
to \(X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\) is the exact image of the abstract
minimal realization.  The positive cone in
\cref{def:ns-generated-productions} is the corresponding image of the
general production family.  The scale valuation is
\eqref{eq:ns-viscous-price-scaling} together with the covariant scale current
\eqref{eq:ns-scale-carrier-current}; the nonlinear polarization and pressure
descent are
\cref{prop:ns-defect-polarization}; and functorial constraint and boundary
descent gives the local, harmonic, exterior, and Leray coordinates.

First apply
\cref{thm:target-local-fact-factorization,cor:no-unscoped-reachability-inference}
on \(X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\); this forbids charging a source occurrence from a
different shell, origin, mode, or scale record.  Then apply
\cref{thm:target-cyclic-joint-kernel-descent}.  Its admitted physical-charge
and target-null cases give \textup{(S1)} and \textup{(S2)}.  Ordering the six
Navier--Stokes total interfaces as in
\cref{def:ns-collapsed-successor-cells} identifies its proper-successor case
with \textup{(S3)}.  If every finite interface is ordinary, form the
cumulative joint record.  By
\cref{thm:continuum-composition-no-creation}, a nonzero component exposed by
a finite joint prefix returns to \textup{(S3)}.  If no new component exists,
the fixed record preserves the moving equation, incompressibility, pressure
equation, signed suitable-energy carrier, chart covariance, unnormalized
shell cocycle, same-origin coordinate, and cofinal shell crossings.  These
are precisely the input rows of \textup{(S4)}.  Apply
\cref{thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion}; target-nullity and cone membership
return to the closed branches, while a separator is a proper successor.
Only on the primal--polar fixed cell apply the ordinary realization map; a
nonordinary realization or a new joint component becomes a proper successor.
An ordinary target-active realization enters the canonical target orbit and
its complete cumulative-current calculation.  The total graph accounts for
each analytic failure named in the statement, so none is a premise.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Navier--Stokes target-aligned reduction]
\label{thm:ns-target-aligned-reduction}
Fix a rational physical stratum \(E>0\).  Every finite-energy singular
contact in \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\) for \eqref{eq:ns-public-equation}
produces a full active signature
\(\mathfrak b=(A,m,\Gamma,1/5,\mathbf R)\).  On its finite-expenditure
successor branch, evaluation of
\(\mathcal K^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\) gives either a
finite \(-1\)-identity, which contradicts that contact branch, or a positive
functional on the same-origin ordered path algebra satisfying:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item support in \(X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\), with every retained
coordinate lying on a forward five-source and backward singular-shell
incidence path;
\item the normalized Navier--Stokes weak equation and incompressibility;
\item the exact moving-microscope equation and the signed local carrier
identity;
\item the pressure local/harmonic/tail graph relations;
\item the target-retaining scale-carrier cohomology relation and, on the
ordinary recurrent cell, the saturation law
\(\int(F_{\rm sc}-D-M)\dd\varpi=0\), together with the totalized-tail
identity \eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-zero-mode} and the \(a<0\) balance
\eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-balance};
\item the target-cyclic adjoint relations
\eqref{eq:ns-adjoint-linearized-operator}, Reynolds-defect polarization,
and every generated production and joint-kernel coordinate; and
\item same-origin parabolic refinement and positive singular-shell pairing.
\end{enumerate}
The fixed-scale part of this functional is target-null.  Its nonzero target
projection is supported on the generated disjoint union
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-exact-retained-union}
 \mathscr Z_{\rm NS}^{*}
 :=\bigsqcup_{\mathfrak b\in\mathfrak B_{\rm NS}^{\rm reach}}
 \bigcup_{\xi\in\{\mathrm{eq,nl,pr,ext,sc,cyc,ord}\}}
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^\xi},
\end{equation}
where
\(\mathfrak B_{\rm NS}^{\rm reach}
:=\bigcup_{E\in\mathbb Q_{>0}}\mathfrak B_{\rm NS}^{\rm reach}(E)\).
Distinct origin, mode, shell, scale, or
earlier polarity records remain distinct components.
Consequently, finite ordered derivations
\[
 -1\in\mathcal K^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^\xi}
\]
exclude that active successor cell.  If every algebraically reachable signature is
excluded, shell accountability excludes singular contact on the declared
finite-energy datum class.  On a complementary cone value, the hierarchy
reconstructs the complete target-aligned scale-saturation model in that same
cell and immediately applies the zero-price resaturation successor.  The
model is not terminal: it either
reaches a finite contradiction, moves to a proper typed successor, or
enters cumulative joint saturation.  The latter exposes another finite
five-channel successor or, at a fixed point with ordinary realization,
enters the canonical target-retaining orbit and cumulative-current rebasing.
The terminal discharge is \cref{thm:ns-empty-singular-target-core}.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Contact gives the disjoint derived shell-current cascade and persistent
signature \(\mathfrak b\).  Equation \eqref{eq:ns-single-physical-budget}
makes the raw event expenditures summable.  After target-local five-source
factorization, the divergent admissible-price branch is impossible, while
the finite branch has a zero-expenditure subsequence; a failed charging
relation remains a typed successor.  Passing to the covariant microscope preserves
the shell current by \cref{prop:ns-no-free-shrinkage}.  Signed carrier gluing
cancels paired interior convection, pressure, cutoff, translation, and exact
chart currents; pressure gauge and exterior tails remain in their typed
coordinates.  By \cref{thm:ns-microscope-passivity}, an infinite ordinary
chain cannot have strict carrier deficit and therefore satisfies the
saturation law.  Successor recurrence and the branch-local alternative
\cref{thm:ordered-proof-or-model} either produce the excluding identity or
the functional with
\textup{(i)}--\textup{(vii)}.  The fixed-scale component is target-null by
\cref{lem:ns-fixed-scale-closure};
\cref{prop:ns-collapsed-cell-exhaustion} gives
\eqref{eq:ns-exact-retained-union}.  Weak duality proves exclusion separately
on each \(\mathfrak b^\xi\), and
\cref{thm:continuum-composition-no-creation,%
thm:ns-target-cyclic-stress-test,thm:no-terminal-zero-price-model,%
cor:ns-ordinary-cell-resaturation}
continues every complementary model.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Navier--Stokes specialization commutes with the structural
compiler]
\label{thm:ns-specialization-commutes}
Let \(\mathsf S_{\rm NS}\) denote substitution of the public relations
\textup{(B1)}--\textup{(B5)} into the continuum presentation, and fix an
algebraically reachable active signature \(\mathfrak b\).  Let
\(\mathsf P_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\),
\(\mathsf F_{\mathfrak b}\), \(\mathsf R_{\mathfrak b}\), and
\(\mathsf O_{\mathfrak b}\) denote respectively target-local fact
projection-first saturation, fact factorization, first-nonordinary successor
completion, and ordered-cone completion.  Let
\(\mathsf H^N_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) form the unnormalized \(N\)-layer
same-origin horizon problem.  Let
\(\mathsf{Pol}_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) be recursive carrier-polar
exhaustion.  Let
\(\mathsf C_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) be circulation formation and let
\(\mathsf B^n_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) be depth-
\(n\) target-aligned branch-and-bound.  Let
\(\mathsf I_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) be bidirectional incidence minimization.
Let \(\mathsf E_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) form the complete expanded derivation
of every generated composite, retaining all physical owners, normalization
denominators, and intermediate cross terms before target projection.
Let \(\mathsf J^n_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) form the cumulative joint record of
the first \(n\) same-origin compiler states, close it under every generated
mixed operation and polarization, and reapply the target projection.
Then
\begin{align}
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf P_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf P_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-projection}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf F_{\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf F_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-fact}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf R_{\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf R_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-successor}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf O_{\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf O_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-cone}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf H^N_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf H^N_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-horizon}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf{Pol}_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf{Pol}_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-carrier-polar}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf C_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf C_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-circulation}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf I_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf I_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-incidence}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf E_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf E_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-expanded-derivation}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf J^n_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf J^n_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS},
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-joint}\\
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}\mathsf B^n_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}
 &=\mathsf B^n_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\mathsf S_{\rm NS}.
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-branch-bound}
\end{align}
In particular,
\[
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}(\mathcal K_{\mathfrak b^\xi})
 =\mathcal K_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^\xi},
 \qquad
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}(\Spine_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b})
 =\Spine_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b},
 \qquad
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}(Z_{\mathfrak b^\xi})
 =Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^\xi}
\]
for every generated successor type
\(\xi\in\{\mathrm{eq,nl,pr,ext,sc,cyc,ord}\}\).  Thus the example uses the
same selector, five-source normal form, target quotient, physical charging
row, same-origin refinement, universal expanded-derivation saturation,
unnormalized horizon duality, recursive amplification exhaustion, circulation
duality, finite target-cylinder
cover, cumulative joint saturation, and terminal fixed-atom test as the
abstract calculus.  In particular,
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-commutes-computed-covers}
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}(\mathscr U_n)
 =\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n},
 \qquad
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}(I_n(F))
 =I_{{\rm NS},n}(\mathsf S_{\rm NS}F).
\end{equation}
The specialization acts only by homomorphic substitution.
After applying \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-incidence}, these identities restrict to
\[
 \mathsf S_{\rm NS}
 \left(\mathcal K_{\mathfrak b^\xi}
 \big|_{\lvert\mathsf M_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\rvert}\right)
 =\mathcal K^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^\xi},
 \qquad
 Z_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^\xi}
 \subseteq X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}.
\]
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
All eleven operations are least closures or finite graph restrictions under
fixed constructor lists.
For \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-projection}, substitution preserves every
prospective shell pairing and sends each abstract descent defect
\eqref{eq:target-projection-descent-defect} to its equation, pressure,
exterior, chart, scale, or cyclic Navier--Stokes defect.  Projection-first
saturation therefore gives the commutation identity and the displayed spine
identity.  For \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-fact}, substitution sends the abstract
weak current
to the viscous \(\Geom\) and transport/pressure \(\Caus\) currents, sends
quotient, chart, and terminal constructors to the displayed
\(\Abs\), \(\Lift\), and \(\Bdry\) currents, and preserves restriction to
\(X^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b}\), signed gluing, and the detecting shell
covector after incidence reduction.
It also sends the abstract carrier-domination graph to the local suitable
energy carrier row.  Hence it preserves both sides of the target-aligned
charging rule, rather than identifying raw event expenditure with price.

For \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-successor}, total-graph completion commutes with a
homomorphism: an ordinary value remains ordinary, while the first
nonordinary equation, product, pressure, exterior, scale, or cyclic value is
sent to the correspondingly typed cell with the same origin, mode, shell,
scale, and earlier polarity coordinates.  The remaining ordinary value is
the \(\mathrm{ord}\) cell.  This is precisely
\cref{prop:ns-collapsed-cell-exhaustion}.

Finally, ideal generation, quadratic-module generation, ordered closure, and
restriction to a fixed signature commute with substitution by their universal
properties.  The generators on the Navier--Stokes side are exactly the weak
equation, moving-chart and carrier identities, pressure graphs, adjoint
module, polarized defects, and same-origin relations listed above.  This
proves \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-cone}.

Equation \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-incidence} is
\cref{prop:ns-incidence-reduction}.  Cumulative joining is generated from
finite products, rational polarizations, total graphs, common-origin rows,
and the shell cocycle.  Homomorphic substitution preserves each generator,
their increasing observer algebras, and the five source projections.  It
therefore proves \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-joint}; in particular, a target
component created by a mixed Navier--Stokes coordinate is exposed on the
same finite joint prefix as in the abstract compiler.

Expanded derivation is the free finite constructor DAG followed by
graph-complete saturation.  Homomorphic substitution preserves its vertices,
edges, intermediate cross terms, owner-tagged physical restrictions,
normalization denominators, and total-graph boundary values.  This proves
\eqref{eq:ns-commutes-expanded-derivation}.  In particular, specialization
cannot turn a composite into a primitive or delete the ancestry of a
Navier--Stokes interaction term.
