Layered horizon formation uses only finite products of the specialized edge
graph, adjacent-marginal rows, the unnormalized physical sum, and the
same-origin relations.  Substitution preserves each generator and the
telescoping layer potentials, proving \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-horizon}.
Carrier-polar exhaustion uses closed-cone formation in the generated current
space, rational cylinder separation, adjoint pullback, polarization, and
totalization.  Specialization preserves each operation and maps the abstract
cone \eqref{eq:target-local-carrier-cone} to
\eqref{eq:ns-target-local-carrier-cone}; hence it maps their separators and
all descendants, proving \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-carrier-polar}.
Circulation formation uses only the specialized edge graph, equal-marginal
rows, target-return normalization, and physical valuation.  Substitution
preserves each, proving \eqref{eq:ns-commutes-circulation}.  At finite depth,
substitution also preserves the coordinate enumeration, rational boxes,
moment and localizing matrices, dual identities, and least-unprocessed
coordinate.  Induction on \(n\) proves
\eqref{eq:ns-commutes-branch-bound} and
\eqref{eq:ns-commutes-computed-covers}.  No extra generator can occur by
\cref{prop:specialization-noninterference}, and no generator can be omitted
because each member of the public ledger has been totalized.
\end{proof}

\begin{theorem}[Self-contained Navier--Stokes specialization audit]
\label{thm:ns-backend-scope}
Using only the general continuum calculus and the Navier--Stokes public
presentation, fix a rational physical stratum
\(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\).  The following statements are derived:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(A\arabic*)}]
\item singular contact forces a pre-contact source with alignment at least
  \(1/5\);
\item the raw physical expenditures of its disjoint events are summable;
  they form the additive entropy cocycle
  \eqref{eq:ns-entropy-cocycle}--\eqref{eq:ns-entropy-cocycle-gluing};
  admissible target price is determined separately by the local charging row;
\item every fixed-scale zero-price descendant is target-null;
\item every shrinking descendant remains visible in the covariant microscope,
  obeys \eqref{eq:ns-moving-frame-equation} and
  \eqref{eq:ns-scale-cell-gluing}, and belongs to the explicitly generated
  seven-successor refinement of its full active signature inside
  \(\mathscr Z_{\rm NS}^{*}\) in
  \eqref{eq:ns-exact-retained-union};
\item the shell covector generates the explicit adjoint module
  \eqref{eq:ns-target-cyclic-module}, Reynolds and pressure defects generate
  \eqref{eq:ns-reynolds-defect-positive}--\eqref{eq:ns-defect-pressure}, and
  forward source ancestry intersects this backward module in
  \(\mathsf M_{{\rm NS},\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\).  The common zero-production
  dynamics is \eqref{eq:ns-target-cyclic-joint-kernel} restricted to that
  minimal realization.  The compressed linearized response
  \eqref{eq:ns-target-active-resolvent} has the source factorization
  \eqref{eq:ns-resolvent-source-factorization};
\item target-local joint-kernel descent gives an admissible divergent physical
  charge, target-nullity,
  one of the six typed proper successors, or a cumulative joint state.  Every
  child is joined with its complete predecessor transcript and reprojected;
  an infinite chain is target-null, exposes a least unprocessed finite joint
  increment, or reaches a structural atom after all increments are
  source-resolved and every cumulative owner is primal--polar fixed.  The
  last case enters the canonical same-origin orbit and cumulative-current
  rebasing.  A stationary functional,
  closed subsystem, raw path, or nonordinary realization value is
  resaturated and is never returned as a terminal answer.
\item specialization commutes with projection-first saturation, target-local
  factorization, total-graph successor completion, ordered-cone completion,
  bidirectional incidence minimization, unnormalized finite-horizon
  formation, universal expanded-derivation saturation, recursive
  amplification exhaustion, circulation formation, finite
  target-aligned branch-and-bound completion, and cumulative joint
  saturation and reprojection; hence every branch decision is made on the Navier--Stokes target
  spine inside \(\mathcal K^{\min}_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b^\xi}\), with the full
  algebraically generated signature retained.
\item every Navier--Stokes sum, product, convection--pressure interaction,
  cutoff localization, stopping interval, parabolic rescaling, empirical
  return law, weak limit, Reynolds defect, concentration profile, tail, and
  boundary value is evaluated through the same expanded-derivation join.
  Consequently no collection of individually regular, small, summable, or
  target-null Navier--Stokes terms can create an unowned singularity-forming
  contribution: a nonzero joint effect is re-entered as a five-source owner
  and undergoes universal recursive amplification exhaustion.
\item the aggregate feeding class is evaluated before its support modes; a
  nonzero class creates the next target-aligned successor, while its zero
  cell gives \eqref{eq:ns-record-scale-zero-mode}.  Exact storage currents
  are retained separately, and every cofinal recurrent-current chain is
  processed by the single recurrent closure queue and its cumulative join
  until it is target-null, has a finite proper typed successor, or is a fixed
  joint atom.  Before normalization, every finite layered horizon is tested
  against the full physical ceiling by
  \eqref{eq:ns-unnormalized-horizon-dual}.  Every surviving cumulative owner
  is then processed by \cref{thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion}; a separator and
  all of its adjoint and polarization descendants re-enter the same queue.
  Only on the primal--polar fixed cell are the sharp cycle price
  and carrier potential computed by
  \eqref{eq:ns-sharp-cycle-price}; zero price supplies the next circulation
  support.
\item the finite Navier--Stokes target programs compute decreasing rational
outer covers \(\mathscr U_{{\rm NS},n}(E)\) of the relaxed mechanism core on
  \(\mathscr X_{\rm NS}(E)\).  Every
  deleted box carries a checked local identity, every retained box is refined
  at its least target-visible coordinate, and
  \eqref{eq:ns-target-observable-enclosures} gives two-sided values for
  rational cylinder observables and graph observables with a verified
  cylinder-approximation modulus.
\item the continuation shells construct the shell-selected same-origin
  microscope record of \cref{thm:ns-canonical-target-orbit}.  Its positive
  quotient-activity cell computes the scale-dependent normalized price
  schedule \eqref{eq:ns-computed-critical-price}; its vanishing-activity cell
  returns to target-local ordered evaluation with the unnormalized shell
  ledger.  The complete signed five-source
  current then obeys \eqref{eq:ns-terminal-financing}.  Persistent current is
  rebased at its first target-visible logarithmic support.  Infinite rebasing
  produces the exhaustive critical tail of
  \cref{thm:ns-critical-tail-nullity}.  Its unnormalized numerator is compared
  with the original physical carrier by
  \cref{thm:exact-compositional-physical-accounting}, yielding exactly a
  bounded-density regular cell, an unbounded five-source amplification spine,
  or a five-source physical-singular spine.
\end{enumerate}
Let \(\mathsf T_{{\rm NS},\Sigma}^{\Phys,\Sat}(E)\) denote the restriction of
\eqref{eq:total-prospective-profile} to the Navier--Stokes specialization.
The derivation establishes the following necessary contact test on every
ordinary same-origin contact record:
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-internal-regularity-equivalence}
 \boxed{
 \text{contact}
 \Longrightarrow
 \Gamma_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}^\perp\ne0
 \ \text{or}\
 \|f_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}\|_{L^\infty(\mu_{\Phys})}=\infty.}
\end{equation}
Every formal inverse-limit record and raw contacting path passes through
cumulative joint reprojection, five-source rebasing, and the critical-tail
discharge.  The initial seed of its resaturation is not the
degenerate product stratum \(p=r(D+M)=0\); it is the smaller target projection
of the covariant saturation kernel
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:ns-refinement-kernel}
 \Pi_{\Sigma_{\rm sing}}
 \left(
 \begin{aligned}
  &\{r=0,p=0\}\cap\ker I_{\rm movNS}
   \cap\{I_{\mathfrak b}=0\}
   \cap\ker I_{\rm car}^{\rm signed}\\
  &{}\cap\ker I_{\rm succ}^{\rm same\text{-}origin}
   \cap\left\{\int(F_{\rm sc}-D-M)\,\dd\varpi=0\right\}\\
  &{}\cap\left\{\int(P+\tfrac a2O+B_\infty)\,\dd\varpi=0\right\}
   \cap X^\infty_{{\rm NS},\mathfrak b,\Phi}
   \cap\mathscr Z_{\rm car}^{\rm tot}
 \end{aligned}
 \right).
\end{equation}
Every recurrent nonlinear, pressure, exterior, covariance, or target-cyclic
boundary is kept as a typed first-failure successor and resaturated.  On the ordinary
row, \cref{cor:ns-ordinary-cell-resaturation} removes the tail-free \(a=0\)
cell or sends the \(a<0\) scale-balance row to circulation and
least-coordinate refinement.  Thus scale collapse
cannot be used as a zero-cost disappearance of normalized structure, and
neither a positive functional nor the displayed kernel is a terminal output.
By \cref{thm:ns-recurrent-component-reduction}, every ordinary fixed-scale or
tail-free \(a=0\) zero mode is target-null, while every scale-relative or
remaining target-visible value is retained as a typed recurrent current.
The cumulative-current theorem retains the remaining scale-relative values
with their physical denominators.  First-scale rebasing and critical-tail
accounting then compute their absolutely continuous amplification density and
physical-singular component.  Thus
\eqref{eq:ns-internal-regularity-equivalence} is a prospective amplification
consequence of contact, not a converse reachability theorem.  The
unbounded-density and physical-singular cells remain source-owned inputs to
the covariant-corona, carrier--polar, and ordinary-realization transitions;
the measure decomposition promotes neither cell to a singular orbit or to
regularity.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Items \textup{(A1)} and \textup{(A2)} are
\cref{thm:ns-prospective-contact-compiler,%
prop:ns-physical-entropy-cocycle}; item \textup{(A3)} is
\cref{lem:ns-fixed-scale-closure}; item \textup{(A4)} follows from
\cref{prop:ns-moving-microscope-equation,thm:ns-signed-covariant-carrier,%
prop:ns-collapsed-cell-exhaustion}; item \textup{(A5)} is
\cref{prop:ns-adjoint-current-image,prop:ns-defect-polarization,%
prop:ns-incidence-reduction,prop:ns-compressed-resolvent-factorization}; item
\textup{(A6)} is \cref{thm:ns-target-cyclic-stress-test}; and
\textup{(A7)} is \cref{thm:ns-specialization-commutes}; item \textup{(A8)} is
\cref{thm:three-output-target-aligned-current-compiler,%
thm:ns-recurrent-component-reduction,%
thm:ns-carrier-polar-recursion,%
cor:ns-target-spine-circulation-evaluator}; item \textup{(A9)} is
\cref{thm:ns-finite-stage-target-evaluation}; and item \textup{(A10)} is
\cref{thm:ns-canonical-target-orbit,lem:ns-computed-critical-price,%
thm:ns-cumulative-current-rebasing,thm:ns-critical-tail-nullity}.
The preceding items reduce every putative contact to the complete
same-origin target current.  The final item rebases that current rather than
discarding its fixed support: persistent supply is retained
and its critical tail is decomposed relative to the original physical
carrier.  This is precisely the necessary implication in
\cref{thm:ns-empty-singular-target-core}, which proves
\eqref{eq:ns-internal-regularity-equivalence}.  No step divides by
\(r\), by the number of returns, or by accumulated target progress.
\end{proof}

The refinement is constructive and internal.  The weak equation first
generates the moving-frame identity
\eqref{eq:ns-moving-frame-equation}; multiplication by \(V\phi\) generates
\eqref{eq:ns-covariant-carrier-identity}; oriented overlap summation generates
\eqref{eq:ns-scale-cell-gluing}; and recurrent averaging generates
\eqref{eq:ns-scale-saturation-law}.  These operations replace the invalid
division by \(r\) with a scale-critical conservation law.  The ordered
hierarchy is then applied to the seven successor cells generated by the six
totalized interfaces, using only consequences
of the displayed weak equation.  A target-relative estimate, compactness
assertion, or rigidity conclusion is not backend input: it must be generated
by multiplier, localization, signed gluing, quotient, or
completion-of-squares operations.

The cellwise refinement order is fixed.  On the equation cell, localize the
least failed weak coordinate and reapply the approximation first-failure map.
On the nonlinear cell, polarize the failed product coordinate and pass each
nonnegative concentration descendant through the target quotient.  On the
pressure cell, apply the Poisson constraint, quotient time-dependent
constants, and separate the local and harmonic coordinates before taking a
positive part.  On the exterior cell, glue all common faces first; the
remaining positive exterior variation is either charged to
\(\mu_{\rm NS}\) through the target-local charging rule or propagated as a
\(\Bdry\) successor.  On the scale cell,
quotient exact scale coboundaries and retain the nonexact harmonic scale
coordinate.  On the target-cyclic cell, apply
\eqref{eq:ns-adjoint-linearized-operator}, polarize the first failed nonlinear
coordinate, descend its pressure defect, and append every generated
Dirichlet or commutator production.  On the ordinary collapsed cell,
continue the same cyclic enumeration from the restricted shell covector and
add every derived nonnegative square to the quadratic module.  Each operation either
lowers the first-failure index, removes the target projection, produces
divergent physical expenditure, or strengthens the defining relations of the
zero-price resaturation state.  The strengthened state is immediately
restricted and reselected; it is never returned as a positive-model
conclusion.  These are generated successor edges, not additional
specialization data.

The finite computation follows the same order.  At depth \(n\), the program
forms the target quotient first, inserts the first \(n\) Navier--Stokes graph
and production rows, imposes equal circulation marginals, and minimizes the
generated physical-price envelope on each rational target box.  A positive
dual value telescopes its carrier potential over recurrent returns.  A
primal zero value restricts the next program to the positive support of the
zero-density circulation after restoring its multiplicity cocycle.  The least unprocessed equation, nonlinear, pressure,
exterior, scale, cyclic, or ordinary coordinate determines the next finite
partition.  Consequently every refinement has a checked local cause, and
the computed covers converge to the target mechanism core in the canonical
evaluation metric.

\subsection{Regulator-to-continuum spectral problems}

The quantum mass-gap problem is a spectral-limit problem rather than a
classical continuation target.  Its structural presentation therefore starts
with finite regulators and constructs the continuum Hilbert space.

\begin{definition}[Public regulator tower]
\label{def:public-regulator-tower}
A public regulator tower consists of compact finite configuration spaces
\(X_\lambda\), probability measures \(\mu_\lambda\), reflection maps
\(\theta_\lambda\), gauge-invariant rational cylinder algebras
\(\mathcal O_\lambda\), positive-time subalgebras
\(\mathcal O_{\lambda,+}\), and refinement, block, and volume maps.  All are
generated from a finite local action and compact gauge measure.  The ordered
relations include normalization, gauge invariance, projective consistency,
locality, and reflection positivity
\begin{equation}
 \label{eq:finite-reflection-positivity}
 \int \overline{\theta_\lambda F}\,F\,\dd\mu_\lambda\ge0,
 \qquad F\in\mathcal O_{\lambda,+}.
\end{equation}
Ultraviolet, infrared, volume, topological, and failed-consistency values are
typed graph coordinates.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Continuum reconstruction is an output]
\label{thm:continuum-reconstruction-output}
Let \(L\) be a projectively consistent positive functional on the
graph-complete regulator algebra satisfying locality, nontriviality, and
reflection positivity.  Quotienting the positive-time cylinder algebra by
the null space of
\[
 \langle F,G\rangle_{\rm OS}:=L(\overline{\theta F}G)
\]
and completing gives a Hilbert space \(\mathcal H_L\) and vacuum vector
\(\Omega_L=[1]\).  If the generated time-translation graph is a strongly
continuous contraction semigroup, it has a nonnegative self-adjoint
generator \(H_L\).  Failure of projective consistency, reflection positivity,
nontriviality, or strong continuity remains its typed regulator-limit graph
value; none of these properties is assumed in a spectral conclusion.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Reflection positivity makes the displayed form positive semidefinite.
Quotienting its null space and completing gives \(\mathcal H_L\); the constant
cylinder defines \(\Omega_L\).  The semigroup property descends from the
time-translation graph, and contractivity follows from its ordered relation.
A strongly continuous self-adjoint contraction semigroup has the form
\(e^{-tH_L}\) for a unique nonnegative self-adjoint generator
\citep{OsterwalderSchrader1973,ReedSimonI1980}.  Every failed antecedent is
already a graph coordinate of the regulator tower.
\end{proof}

\begin{definition}[Prospective gap target]
\label{def:prospective-gap-target}
At finite regulator, let \(\Gamma_{\rm gap}\) be the normalized cone generated
by vacuum-orthogonal low-energy filters and positive-time correlation shells.
The target-active quotient removes all observable and regulator directions
annihilated by \(\Gamma_{\rm gap}\).  Gap failure is the existence of
\[
 \|\psi_n\|=1,\qquad \psi_n\perp\Omega_L,\qquad
 \langle\psi_n,H_L\psi_n\rangle\longrightarrow0.
\]
The source compiler assigns form geometry to \(\Geom\), directed transfer to
\(\Caus\), gauge quotient to \(\Abs\), refinement and block motion to
\(\Lift\), and ultraviolet, infrared, and volume faces to \(\Bdry\).
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Uniform spectral-gap proof/model alternative]
\label{thm:uniform-gap-proof-model}
For the target-aligned regulator path algebra, exactly one alternative holds:
\begin{enumerate}[label=\textup{(\roman*)}]
\item a finite ordered derivation gives a rational \(\Delta>0\) and proves,
uniformly in the retained regulator and volume coordinates,
\[
 \langle\psi,H\psi\rangle\ge\Delta\|\psi\|^2,
 \qquad \psi\perp\Omega;
\]
\item compatible feasible moment levels reconstruct a projectively consistent
positive functional carrying a normalized vacuum-orthogonal zero-energy
spectral model, together with its ultraviolet, infrared, gauge, topological,
and boundary coordinates.
\end{enumerate}
When the first alternative is combined with a zero-defect functional satisfying
\cref{thm:continuum-reconstruction-output}, the reconstructed Hamiltonian has
a mass gap at least \(\Delta\).  The theorem does not infer existence of the
continuum theory from a spectral derivation alone.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
Adjoin the Rayleigh inequality with indeterminate rational \(\Delta\), vacuum
orthogonality, regulator consistency, and the prospective gap floor to the
ordered regulator algebra.  Apply
\cref{thm:ordered-proof-or-model,thm:proof-producing-hierarchy-completeness}.
The dual branch is the uniform ordered inequality in \textup{(i)}.  The primal
branch is the positive functional in \textup{(ii)}.  Under continuum
reconstruction, the quadratic-form inequality implies
\(\sigma(H_L)\cap(0,\Delta)=\varnothing\) by the spectral theorem.
\end{proof}

\begin{corollary}[Spectral realization boundary]
\label{cor:spectral-realization-boundary}
Resolvent poles, pseudospectral growth, loss of closed range, regulator moment
models, and zero-energy positive functionals are spectral or graph
coordinates, not PDE-contact or quantum-existence terminals.  A spectral
coordinate changes a physical reachability conclusion only through an
explicit same-origin realization map intertwining the public evolution,
target shells, and physical carrier.  A regulator gap conclusion additionally
requires the zero-defect reflection-positive reconstruction of
\cref{thm:continuum-reconstruction-output}.  Thus the Hamiltonian calculus
does not assume a Hilbert space, operator domain, vacuum, strongly continuous
semigroup, or continuum limit that the public regulator tower has not
constructed.
\end{corollary}

\begin{proof}
The target-local fact-factorization theorem permits a reachability use only
after the relation is restricted to a source--target incidence path.  The
approximation--orbit realization criterion supplies the corresponding PDE
condition.  In the regulator setting, reflection positivity constructs the
pre-Hilbert form, while projective consistency, nontriviality, and strong
continuity are exactly the graph values required in
\cref{thm:continuum-reconstruction-output}.  The spectral theorem applies
only after those values are ordinary.  Hence none of the listed analytic
coordinates can bypass realization.
\end{proof}

\section{Conclusion}

The continuum extension is a physical reachability theory generated from the
same five-source algebra as Part~I.  The graph-complete approximation tower
adds the compactness needed in function space without adding a source.
Sourcewise completion retains every concentration, oscillation, defect, tail,
trace, and germ in the ancestry cell that generated it.  The residual is the
post-completion target kernel and therefore carries no singular progress.

The decisive prospective statement is exact: contact crosses every target
shell, and the derived cylinder-current identity assigns the resulting unit
progress to five source-resolved Stieltjes currents.  One source contributes
at least \(1/5\).  Disjoint shell extraction then confronts that aligned
source with the only budget in the theory, the countably additive physical
expenditure generated by the equation's carrier law.  Divergent physical
price excludes the cascade.  Finite price forces a zero-price same-origin
successor model; it does not create an unresolved source.

Recurrent evaluation uses one further target-local quotient.  Compatible
carrier cells are glued with signs, and their aggregate feeding current is
reduced modulo shift coboundaries, paired faces, exact chart and gauge
currents, and the target kernel.  Projection-first saturation permits this
quotient before descendant generation; every failed descent is retained in
the target-cyclic spine.  Only the aggregate row
\(\mathfrak J_{\Sigma,\mathfrak b}\) of
\eqref{eq:passivity-fast-track-class} is evaluated.  A nonzero value supplies
its signed-dyadic return law as the next source occurrence; a nonordinary
value supplies its graph witness; and zero feeding forces the generated
nonnegative production to vanish in the stationary law.  Exact endpoint
storage is retained separately and followed by the same return construction.
This single passivity fast track replaces separate compactness, pressure,
tail, scale, and equality estimates whenever those modes are support
coordinates of the same signed current.

The recurrent price is computed by target-current circulation duality.  The
primal problem searches for a flow-conserving unit target return of zero
physical price.  The dual problem searches the generated cylinder algebra for
a carrier potential whose coboundary absorbs target return into physical
production.  Positive dual value closes the recurrent cell; zero value
constructs the circulation support used by the next refinement.  Iterated
circulation elimination has empty relaxed core exactly when no saturated
prospective source atom survives on the target spine.  An empty core yields a
regularity proof only through the checked finite deletion identities at the
finite empty level.  A nonempty relaxed core is represented by a nested
sequence of finite target-cylinder outer covers; rational cylinder readouts
and total-graph readouts with verified approximation moduli converge from
both sides.  Its compatible words reconstruct prospective source-profile
records with their origin polarity unchanged.  Only compatible words
produced by an independent public-orbit constructor reconstruct same-origin
singular evolutions.

The final evaluation is algebraic.  There are only \(2^5-1\) nonempty source
supports and the shell normalization fixes the target floor at \(1/5\).
Each support initializes one recurrent closure queue.  Before a local cone
is generated, forward source ancestry and backward target observability are
intersected in the minimal target-active realization.  Finite graph pruning
therefore removes every coordinate that cannot lie on a complete
source--target path.  The remaining local cone
enumerates finite rational exclusions; its complementary positive functional
is immediately processed by zero-kernel restriction, signed-dyadic return,
or typed graph continuation.  Compactness, pressure, tail, scale, fidelity,
and equality values are coordinates of this queue.  The three-output theorem
returns divergent physical charge, target-nullity, or a saturated prospective
source-profile witness.  Only an independently generated ordinary same-origin
realization of the third value establishes a path contacting every cofinal
target shell.  Thus the continuum calculus follows only structure aligned
with singular formation and never promotes a contact-derived structural
witness to physical existence.

The resulting criterion is exact on each finite physical stratum:
singular reachability is equivalent to the existence of a realized path in a
reachable target spine.  Global regularity is the emptiness of these realized
spines.  The queue evaluates that property using only local target currents,
their physical valuation, and their generated return or graph transitions.

The Wick map gives a quantitative learning realization of an existing
Part~I compensated record.  It complexifies the record and replaces only
\(-H_{\Abs}\) by \(-iH_{\Abs}\); the real dissipative \(\Geom\), authorized
\(\Caus\) bridge, authority, ancestry, and charges are inherited unchanged.
The transformed record yields an exact self-energy, memory equation, physical
budget, and least-action law.  The positive full-
response kernel transfers the learning bounds of Part~I without imposing
normality.  Its Rademacher traces are the finite Part~I evaluation
compressions, while its population effective dimension is the totalized
positive trace in \([0,\infty]\).  Dynamics are fitted by a constrained block likelihood;
unrestricted authority uses inverse-response kernel ridge regression on the
zero-waste bridge fiber; and RL uses action-safe fitted Bellman regression
with a Gibbs policy loss and an explicit deployment converter.  The
inverse-response norm is the exact minimum latent response energy.  An
exact-cell Rademacher union and learned-operator cover, or the structural
PAC--Bayes mixture and coefficient-selection charge, select the family by the
same rule as Part~I.  These quantities restrict the saturated profile to the
declared risk tolerance; the result is the Pareto-minimal frontier of its
strict inverse at the inherited target threshold.  Minimum readout capacity,
established by the target-subspace projection identity, remains an inner
coordinate of each fixed response.  The same learner also returns the
unrestricted saturated profile at a resource/action ceiling.  Free, hybrid,
and imposed authority differ only through
their legal current families; no target-aligned current is substituted for
the selected dynamics.
